{
  "edges": [
    {
      "fromKey": "n-ufqg50",
      "toKey": "n-1m3lip6",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The maintenance was deferred (condition) because the crew held current qualifications but lacked evidence of a recent briefing or specific configuration drawing visibility, which may have contributed to an inability to diagnose the localized pressure drop effectively.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1", "7e69d300-c57e-40a8-bb37-35a61073ff33#1"],
      "claimIds": ["finding-cildw8"],
      "counterfactual": "If the crew had received a recent briefing and seen the specific configuration drawing, they might have identified the localized issue faster or prevented it.",
      "competingExplanation": "The pressure drop could be due to equipment failure unrelated to lack of briefing; however, without evidence of such failure, this remains an alternative hypothesis.","evidenceGap":"Need confirmation on whether a recent change briefing was conducted and if specific configuration drawings were reviewed by the crew before the incident. This would clarify if knowledge gaps contributed to the event or if it was purely equipment-related."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1rshp0p",
      "toKey": "n-1pmr9gx",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The alarm AL-44 mapped to P-R pressure, not compressor status; the 'COMP FAULT' label is a legacy display artifact. This mislabeling could have led to confusion about the source of the air-low indication during boundary preparation.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds":["da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c759c#1"],
      "claimIds": ["finding-11cpm89"],
      "counterfactual":"If the alarm label accurately reflected its input mapping, operators might have correctly identified the pressure drop at P-R rather than assuming a compressor fault.",
      "competingExplanation":"The legacy display artifact may not have been noticed by operators; however, this remains an alternative hypothesis until further evidence is gathered.","evidenceGap": "Need confirmation on whether operators were aware of the alarm label discrepancy and if it impacted their response to the air-low indication."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-17qciec",
      "toKey": "n-1pmr9gx",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale":"The shift log records 'boundary preparation in progress' but does not identify point of interruption or valve states. This lack of detail could have hindered effective troubleshooting and response to the air-low indication.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds":["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
      "claimIds": ["finding-lcx7sq","claim-7262ne"],
      "counterfactual":"If the shift log had identified the point of interruption and valve states, operators might have taken more targeted actions to resolve the issue.",
      "competingExplanation":"The lack of detail in the shift log may not be a significant factor if other communication channels were effective; however, this remains an alternative hypothesis until further evidence is gathered.","evidenceGap": "Need confirmation on whether additional records or communications provided details about the point of interruption and valve states that could have aided troubleshooting."
    }
  ],
  "decision": {
    "summary": "The incident involved a localized pressure drop at P-R during boundary preparation, leading to an air-low indication. Contributing factors include mislabeled alarms, lack of detailed shift log entries, and potential knowledge gaps due to missing briefings or configuration drawing reviews.",
    "evidenceUsed": ["finding-cildw8", "finding-11cpm89", "finding-lcx7sq","claim-7262ne"],
    "unknowns": [
      "Whether a recent change briefing was conducted and if specific configuration drawings were reviewed by the crew.",
      "If operators were aware of the alarm label discrepancy and its impact on their response."
    ],
    "alternatives": ["Equipment failure unrelated to knowledge gaps or communication issues", "Effective use of other communication channels despite lack of detailed shift log entries"],
    "confidence": 0.75
  },"evidenceRequests":[
    "requestId-1","sourceId:24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1,claimRef=finding-lcx7sq",
    "requestId-2","sourceId:d838e866-dc34-4814-8dad-3b97d0353f05#1,claimRef=finding-cildw8"
  ]}
